description: This PHP source file defines the ViewSearchView class, which extends ViewListView, for handling search view interfaces within the SuiteCRM ModuleBuilder module. It manages layout editing, module title parameters, and AJAX navigation for search view configuration.

classes.name: ViewSearchView
classes.description: A class extending ViewListView to manage search view layouts and AJAX navigation in SuiteCRM's ModuleBuilder.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the view, setting the layout if provided in the request.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns the module title parameters for display, including the module name and title.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Overridden to prevent loading a bean for a non-existent module.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the search view, optionally in preview mode, using Smarty templates and AJAX.

methods.name: constructAjax
methods.description: Builds the AJAX navigation breadcrumbs and sets the view title based on the layout.
